CATS.label: Roads, footpaths
CATS.agency: GMDA for master roads, MCG for internal roads
CATS.owns: GMDA owns the master roads between sectors and the major corridors. MCG owns internal roads, lanes and footpaths. HSVP keeps its own sectors until transfer; developers keep licensed colonies under DTCP. NH-48 and the expressways are NHAI.

No action in time: the officer named on the ticket, then the zone Joint Commissioner or Executive Engineer.
Still pending: MCG Commissioner and Mayor, or GMDA CEO.

ladder: Ticket on the portal or the Swachhata app; keep the number.
Not attended: the ward sanitary inspector, then the zone Joint Commissioner.
Still pending: MCG Commissioner and Mayor.

ladder: Ticket on the portal; keep the number. Only you can close it.

BLOG.t: How to file a civic complaint that gets acted on
BLOG.x: The channel that creates a record, what an engineer needs, and the three moves that turn a grievance into a case.
BLOG.b:
Most complaints in this city die in a WhatsApp group. The ones that get fixed were filed on a channel that creates a ticket, contained what an engineer needs, and someone kept the number.

1. Use the channel that creates a record

For anything civic, start with the GMDA integrated grievance portal: web, toll-free 1800 180 1817, WhatsApp 78400 01817 or the myGurugram app. It routes to MCG, GMDA and MC Manesar, and only the complainant can close a ticket. Electricity is 1912; police matters 112 or the station; a builder, HRERA.

2. Put in what an engineer needs

  • The exact spot: sector, street, landmark, ward number.
  • A dated photo.
  • Since when, and earlier complaint numbers.
  • What you want done, in one line.

3. Keep the number and use the ladder

If the promised time passes, escalate to the officer named on the ticket, then the zone Joint Commissioner or Chief Engineer, then Commissioner and Mayor, then CM Window. Attach the history at each step. Need proof of what was sanctioned? An RTI for the work order costs 10 rupees.

BLOG.t: Your ward councillor: what they can do, and what they cannot
BLOG.x: Gurugram elected 36 councillors in March 2025. What the office controls, and how to work with it.
BLOG.b:
A councillor is the only elected person whose job is your street. They sit in the MCG House, which passes the budget, and on its committees. Turnout in 2025 was under 42 percent, so a few thousand votes decided most wards.

In their power

  • Internal roads, streetlights, parks, sanitation and stray-animal services run by MCG.
  • Ward development funds and the priority list of works.
  • Raising an issue in the House and its committees.

Not in their power

  • Master roads, master drains and bulk water: GMDA.
  • HSVP sectors not yet transferred; licensed colonies still with the developer.
  • Police, electricity, pollution enforcement.

How to work with them

Bring a list, not a grievance: five issues with photos, locations and ticket numbers. Ask which are MCG and what the timeline is. Follow up in writing. The ward directory lists every councillor with official sources.

BLOG.t: The 21-day rule and other deadlines the government set for itself
BLOG.x: Statutory timelines you can quote back: CPGRAMS, Right to Service, RTI, power supply, GRAP.
BLOG.b:
The most useful sentence in a complaint is a deadline the department already agreed to.

  • Central grievances: 21 days. DARPG's August 2024 guidelines set the CPGRAMS redressal time at 21 days, with an interim reply if longer and an appeal if you rate the resolution poor. pgportal.gov.in
  • State services: the notified limit, then automatic appeal. The Auto Appeal System escalates without you filing anything; the Commission can fine the officer.
  • Information: 30 days. RTI replies are due in 30 days, 48 hours where life or liberty is involved. rtionline.gov.in
  • Electricity: HERC standards. DHBVN owes compensation for delay. Helpline 1912.
  • Air: GRAP stages. Restrictions apply automatically as the AQI crosses thresholds; violations go on the Sameer app.

Quote the deadline, attach the date you filed, and the conversation becomes a compliance question.

BLOG.t: Segregate at source: what the 2016 rules ask of every household and society
BLOG.x: Around 1,100 tonnes a day, most of it unprocessed. Half the fix is in residents' hands.
BLOG.b:
Gurugram produces around 1,100 tonnes of waste a day and processes very little of it. The Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016 put duties on both the corporation and the generator.

Every household

  • Three streams: wet, dry, and domestic hazardous (batteries, medicines, sanitary waste, paint).
  • Hand over only to the authorised collector; no dumping, no burning.
  • Construction debris goes to the designated point, not the roadside.

Every society over 100 kg a day

Most gated societies and office complexes are bulk generators. They must process wet waste on site or through an authorised agency. Societies that have done it cut landfill waste by more than half.

What the corporation owes you

Door-to-door collection of segregated waste, separate transport, and processing rather than dumping. Collector mixing your streams? Report it on the GMDA portal or the Swachhata app with a photo. The Forum runs composting set-up clinics for societies.

HI.db.p: हर रिपोर्ट कारण और स्थिति के अनुसार, फ़ोरम के अपने वादों के सामने।
HI.u.p: कहानियाँ, फ़ोटो, वीडियो और प्रेस, फ़ोरम की टीम द्वारा।
HI.jn.p: तीन रास्ते। एक चुनें और विवरण दें।
HI.jn.note: कौशल या वह मुद्दा जो आपको प्रिय है (वैकल्पिक)
HI.a.p: नागरिकों का मंच जो गुरुग्राम की समस्याएँ सही डेस्क तक पहुँचाता है और अंत तक साथ रहता है।
HI.a.o1p: कॉरपोरेट, क़ानून, शिक्षा, नियोजन और मीडिया से 8 से 12 विशेषज्ञ।
HI.a.o2p: संचालन, सरकारी समन्वय और नीति कार्य।
HI.a.o3p: सेक्टर और वार्ड टीमें, सेवा अभियान, शोध सहयोग।
HI.a.t1p: ग़ैर-लाभकारी पंजीकरण प्रक्रिया में है। चार्टर और खाते यहाँ प्रकाशित होंगे।
HI.a.t3p: रिपोर्ट आपके फ़ोन नंबर के बिना साझा होती है। सार्वजनिक पेज पर नाम नहीं दिखता।
HI.a.t4p: फ़ोरम स्वतंत्र और ग़ैर-दलीय है। आपातकाल: 112।
HI.ac.p1: यह साइट WCAG 2.2 स्तर AA का लक्ष्य रखती है: कीबोर्ड, दृश्य फ़ोकस, 44px टैप लक्ष्य, 16px से बड़ा पाठ, रंग अकेले नहीं, कम गति का सम्मान।
HI.ac.p2: ज्ञात कमियाँ: हिंदी इंटरफ़ेस और शीर्षकों तक है, लंबे लेख अभी नहीं; वार्ड नक़्शा बाहरी साइट पर है।
HI.ac.p3: जो काम न करे, हमें बताएँ:
HI.m.title: मेनू
HI.ft.tag: नागरिक और शासन, साझेदारी में। सहयोग, योगदान, बदलाव।
